description: Answers: what are today's top news stories, by section (World, Business, Tech, Science, Health, Sport, Culture, Politics, Environment, Travel, Food, Good News)? Returns up to `per` stories per section from the last 36 hours, each with headline, the publisher's feed summary, publisher, publication time, the publisher's URL and how many publishers covered it. Optional `subject` limits to one section.

lang.description: Edition language code. Each edition carries only articles written natively in that language. Use zh for Simplified, tw for Traditional Chinese.

subject.description: One section id; omit for all sections.

name: news_today
title: Today's top stories by section
